passages.quote:
This document provides an explanation of the powers available to employment tribunals, with examples to illustrate how these powers have been used.

Either party in the tribunal, the employer or employee, can request the use of the powers.

The guidance includes:

an outline of the purpose and limits of the powers

an explanation of how to ask tribunals to make use of the powers

evidence that poor behaviour or conduct in bringing or defending a claim or response can have financial consequences
